answer: A defense is metered action pigments. Each identity gets a unique pigment mix at registration, and each signed action releases a plume into a public stream plus a ripple in the ledger. The ripple must carry the plume's signature, and one identity's ripples share one mix. A counterfeiter running N puppets buys N mixes at full price, since the issuer sells one mix per registration, no bulk discount. Reusing a mix across puppets makes ripples correlate, detectable by scanning. Honest agents buy one mix and keep it; cost scales with N.
